t: You're looking at Cannon Hall, number 14 Cannon Place in Hampstead, a grade two star listed house dating from around 1720. It was the home of the actor Gerald du Maurier, his wife Muriel Beaumont, and their three children, the writers Angela and Daphne du Maurier and the painter Jeanne. The person recorded as dying here is Muriel Thetis Wilson, a British socialite, who lived from 1875 to 1964. So this is a house where family life and later years both played out.
